- Pulse AI: the settings show the model in use and open the Models page; the sort-the-pictures feature is removed.
- Pulse AI drawer: the Models entry is back.
- Files: .dex and other program files open in a viewer (Dalvik header, the text inside, hex); HTML pages run their scripts; SVG and MHTML open as pages.
- Files: zip is written with the phone's own zip classes; 7z uses the fastest setting; starting a new compression clears the old result.
- App icons: icon pack pictures can be black and white or one colour; the chooser shows the looks on black.
- ArtCraft: an app without a bundled icon gets it from its APK.
- Game Hub: a double tap on a game's cover opens its statistics; the page has Delete game and Look for cover; Look for covers in the settings; the Add dialog and the shelf look are black and white; the SteamGridDB key is saved when typing is done.
- Bluetooth autoplay waits for the headphones to be the output, starts once per connection and stays quiet when another app plays or a call is on.
- Phone (held upright): the settings pages and the per-console customize page fit the screen; the quick menu's theme tiles are static.
